options.content:
## Route intelligently. Observe each layer separately.
**Client → SR (ON / OFF) → LiteLLM → vLLM** · Independent live monitoring · 15-second collection

ON / OFF identifies the **service configuration**, not per-request AMX kernel execution. Different live traffic is **not a controlled speedup experiment**. Mode filters apply to all SR panels; Model filters apply only to model-labelled panels. Missing series are never replaced with zero.

panels.title: Router metrics / scrape health
panels.description: 1 = metrics reachable; not inference or backend health.

panels.title: Selected-model requests / second
panels.description: Instrumented request paths, not successful answers. A rejected request may not reach a selected model.

panels.title: Selected-model requests / time range
panels.description: Prometheus extrapolated increase; can be fractional. Only covers data since this collector began, not earlier requests.

panels.title: Routing P95 / rolling window
panels.description: Instrumented ext_proc routing only. Idle window = No samples, not zero latency. Histogram estimate; highest finite bucket 10 s.

panels.title: Model requests / selected time range
panels.description: Not successful response counts. No pre-collection history is reconstructed from cumulative counters.

panels.title: Selected-model counters / since router process start
panels.description: Cumulative process counters at the selected end time; NOT counts within the selected time range. Reset on restart.

panels.title: Decision matches / multiple matches allowed
panels.description: All matched rules, including default-route. Several rules can match one request. Do not use as request count or exclusive route share.

panels.title: Routing / mean & P95
panels.description: Complexity includes embedding + rule scoring, excludes outer gate wait. Routing covers instrumented ext_proc paths, not every API/eval request. Idle = no latency sample.

panels.title: Complexity / mean & P95
panels.description: Complexity includes embedding + rule scoring, excludes outer gate wait. Routing covers instrumented ext_proc paths, not every API/eval request. Idle = no latency sample.

panels.title: Routing / P50 · P95 · P99
panels.description: Bucket-interpolated estimates, not exact percentiles. Highest finite bucket is 10 s; overflow can cap estimates. Do not subtract percentiles.

panels.title: Decision evaluation / mean
panels.description: Rule evaluation only. Distinct from complexity extraction and full routing; not a backend latency.

options.content:
**SR response duration ≠ LiteLLM / Langfuse LLM observation duration.** SR timers use router request context and can include routing, network, queueing and upstream handling; recorded responses may include error bodies. Streaming TTFT records the first body chunk (possibly role-only); non-streaming uses response headers. Neither is guaranteed to be the first visible text token.

**Errors are recorded events, not a reliable success-rate denominator.** Unseen label combinations remain absent. Langfuse observation duration requires the actual LiteLLM trace; this dashboard does not invent trace, cost, or cache-hit data.

panels.title: SR-observed response duration / mean
panels.description: Not Langfuse generation time. Native SR instrumentation can record error responses; zero-traffic windows have no latency.

targets.expr: 1000 * sum by (amx_mode, model) (rate(llm_model_completion_latency_seconds_sum{sr_dashboard="router-operations-v1",amx_mode=~"$mode",model=~"$model",model!="_init"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (amx_mode, model) (rate(llm_model_completion_latency_seconds_count{sr_dashboard="router-operations-v1",amx_mode=~"$mode",model=~"$model",model!="_init"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: SR-observed first chunk / headers / mean
panels.description: Not Langfuse generation time. Native SR instrumentation can record error responses; zero-traffic windows have no latency.

targets.expr: 1000 * sum by (amx_mode, model) (rate(llm_model_ttft_seconds_sum{sr_dashboard="router-operations-v1",amx_mode=~"$mode",model=~"$model",model!="_init"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (amx_mode, model) (rate(llm_model_ttft_seconds_count{sr_dashboard="router-operations-v1",amx_mode=~"$mode",model=~"$model",model!="_init"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Recorded error events / second
panels.description: Native errors only, not complete HTTP status accounting. OFF may have no error series until its first error; missing is not proof of zero errors.

panels.title: Recorded error events / time range
panels.description: Extrapolated event increase. No series means unobserved, not certified zero. Errors can occur before model assignment.

panels.title: SR-recorded tokens / second
panels.description: Token accounting observed by SR, dependent on upstream usage fields. Not authoritative LiteLLM billing or token-generation throughput.

panels.title: Response observations above 10 s / second
panels.description: Observations beyond the highest finite native histogram bucket. Completion quantiles would saturate here; use means and actual traces instead.

targets.expr: sum by (amx_mode, model) (rate(llm_model_completion_latency_seconds_count{sr_dashboard="router-operations-v1",amx_mode=~"$mode",model=~"$model",model!="_init"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (amx_mode, model) (rate(llm_model_completion_latency_seconds_bucket{sr_dashboard="router-operations-v1",amx_mode=~"$mode",model=~"$model",model!="_init",le="10"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Process CPU / cores consumed
panels.description: User + system CPU of router process, including native work. Not node CPU, container quota percent, or AMX utilization.

panels.title: Process resident memory / RSS
panels.description: Router process RSS. Not total Pod memory or cgroup working set; excludes sidecars.

panels.title: Go goroutines
panels.description: Go concurrency; not native threads, active requests, or CPU cores.

panels.title: Legacy GPU metrics targets / NOT current route health
panels.description: Existing separate collector still used obsolete backend IPs at publication. Down scrape targets do not establish LiteLLM route health. Unchanged by this dashboard.

options.content:
- **New collection starts at deployment:** rate/increase needs at least two scrapes. No historical ON/OFF backfill. Cumulative counters can already contain requests from before collection.
- **Idle latency is unknown, not zero:** use a wider time range only if traffic occurred after collection started. No inference or load test was generated to populate charts.
- **Legacy GPU targets:** existing collector IPs are stale. This release does not change them or diagnose current model connectivity.
- **Not collected here:** Langfuse observations, authoritative costs, gate wait, GPU queue time on current backends, cache hits (no live cache series observed), per-request AMX kernel execution.
- **Isolation:** queries select a dedicated collection label to avoid double-counting the old ON-only job. Original SR management UI and AMX benchmark dashboard remain separate.
